title: Frontend analytics handoff and triage - 2026-04-18
body:
Objective: quick handoff from analytics to frontend to address telemetry gaps noticed in last canary and align on instrumentation for the new rollouts page.

Attendees: Priya Patel (owner), Marco Diaz, Alyssa Chen, Ben Kwon, Samira Ali, Tasha O'Neil (observer)

Context / Why: metrics spike during the 95th-99th percentile latency on the rollouts analytics queries. Dashboards currently miss event-level identifiers that make tracing errors back to user journeys hard. We need a small set of changes that unblock immediate debugability and a slightly larger plan for improved observability.

Quick status:
- Rollouts page (UI): currently on canary, ~5% traffic. Frontend changes merged but telemetry hooks partially incomplete.
- Analytics infra: nightly ETL stable, but the event schema has optional fields dropped which broke several joins.
- Instrumentation: frontend sending 'rollout_view' events but missing 'route_id' and 'model_variant' in ~27% of events.

Observed metrics snapshot (from 2026-04-17 22:00 UTC):
- 95th latency for rollout analytics queries: 730ms (baseline target 300ms)
- Error rate for analytics query pipeline: 0.7% (mostly schema mismatch)
- Missing key in events: ~27% of rollouts-view events

Immediate blockers:
- Frontend cannot correlate slow queries to specific rollout IDs because 'route_id' not consistently present in event payloads.
- ETL rejects events that don't conform to the latest schema; current schema change wasn't coordinated with frontend rollout.
- Lack of traces from canary users due to sampling policy; need temporary increased sampling for the next 48h.

Decisions made during meeting:
1) Short-term fix: frontend will add defensive code to include route_id/model_variant in all rollouts-view events (even if null, send explicit null). This prevents ETL from dropping fields.
2) Analytics will add a grace rule to ETL: accept events missing route_id for 72 hours and emit a warning metric instead of rejecting.
3) SRE will raise sampling temporarily to 5% for canary cohort to capture traces for debugging (expires 48h after enable).
4) Create a dedicated smoke query dashboard (low cardinality) for rollouts that refreshes every 30s.

Action items (owner — due):
- Priya: open the PR with defensive telemetry changes + unit tests (PR link to be added) — due 2026-04-19
- Marco: add ETL grace rule and warning metrics, coordinate with infra to monitor backlog — due 2026-04-19
- Ben: update sampling policy in SRE runbook and enable 5% sampling for canary cohort — due 2026-04-18 (end of day)
- Samira: build the smoke dashboard and add to on-call playbook — due 2026-04-20
- Alyssa: run a quick end-to-end test (frontend -> analytics -> dashboard) and write steps to reproduce the issue — due 2026-04-19
- Tasha: loop in product on user-visible risk and get approval for the brief telemetry increase — due 2026-04-18

Notes to self / open questions:
- How many other pages rely on the same event schema? Need inventory before ETL permanent schema changes.
- Is the 'route_id' being dropped by an intermediate CDN or by client-side code? Early evidence points to client instrumentation bug but not confirmed.
- Consider adding schema-version header in events for future migrations.

Follow-ups / checkpoints:
- Quick sync tomorrow 2026-04-19 10:30am PT to verify PR and ETL changes are live.
- Re-evaluate sampling after 48h; decision to keep or revert based on trace usefulness and cost.
- Plan a post-mortem if missing fields continue after temporary fixes — invite infra, frontend, analytics, product.

Links referenced:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CON/console-telemetry
- Jira: ENG-3421 (ETL schema change)
- GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1789 (frontend telemetry WIP)
- Slack: #console-tooling

Casual notes:
- Ben mentioned a quick hack to log raw event payloads to S3 for 24h if we need one-off retro analysis; keep as fallback.
- Priya: TODO add unit test for null route_id case in event serializer.

Next meeting: 2026-04-19 10:30am PT — short standup to confirm actions and flag anything blocking delivery.

Status: draft — will update with PR links and verification logs when available.
